title: Retention Time Prediction by Direct System Mapping
text: rePredRet predicts retention times (RTs) directly mapping chromatographic systems using monotonically constrained Generalized Additive Models (GAMs). Key assumptions: - Elution order largely conserved similar chromatographic systems - Compounds elute early one system tend elute early similar systems algorithm: 1. Find compounds measured source target systems (InChI without stereochemistry) 2. Fit monotonically constrained GAM RT pairs, -weighting outliers 3. Compute 95% prediction intervals whose width follows local scatter compounds, calibrated cross-validation (method = "adaptive_pi", default). method = "fast_ci" gives faster intervals nearly constant width method = "bootstrap" slower bootstrap version See methods article details.
